title: backlog.py cost says when no usage capture exists instead of printing zeros
goal: backlog.py cost on a project or clone whose query log spool holds no usage rows for the id prints its one explanatory line (today: no item line: because no work sidecar names it ...) and then nothing else: no direct, attributed, shared or session-total tables of zeros, exit 0; and the line tells a spool with no usage rows at all (no capture on this clone, with the spool path it read) from a spool with rows that name no window of the item (the session ran without the capture hooks or its rows were not delivered); the kb-sprint review step quotes that line when it sees it, so a review never records zeros as a sprint's cost (SP-fvztfmtm closed with zeros because no work sidecar had been delivered). A project with capture rows for the item is unchanged.

gates.question: How does cost word the two no-capture cases, and what does --json print for them?
options: text: 'no capture: <spool path> holds no usage rows on this clone' when the spool has none, else the existing no item line naming that the spool has usage rows but none in a window of the item; --json keeps its shape with no_line.kind 'no-capture' for the first case and no tables
one line for both cases, telling them apart only in --json
gates.recommendation: text: 'no capture: <spool path> holds no usage rows on this clone' when the spool has none, else the existing no item line naming that the spool has usage rows but none in a window of the item; --json keeps its shape with no_line.kind 'no-capture' for the first case and no tables
gates.answer: text: 'no capture: <spool path> holds no usage rows on this clone' when the spool has none, else the existing no item line naming that the spool has usage rows but none in a window of the item; --json keeps its shape with no_line.kind 'no-capture' for the first case and no tables

gates.question: For a no-line item that no shared line names, which wins when the spool holds no usage row and git also dates the item before the first or after the newest sidecar, and do a shared line's figures and a sprint's overhead stay printed?
options: no-capture wins over the time kinds; a shared line's tables and a sprint's overhead with runs stay printed
the time kinds win and no-capture is only for items with no time reason; everything after the line is dropped
gates.recommendation: no-capture wins over the time kinds; a shared line's tables and a sprint's overhead with runs stay printed
gates.answer: no-capture wins over the time kinds; a shared line's tables and a sprint's overhead with runs stay printed

notes: Premise: python3 _tools/backlog.py cost ST-izba5564 on this clone, an item no session has worked, prints token figures of zero and exits 0 instead of saying no capture exists for it; run before the sprint commits the story and record the output here. The explanatory line exists; the zero tables after it and the missing spool-level distinction are the defect. Order in SP-befc6yqr: last, after ST-zt4fdewi (shared test file and kb-sprint skill). Its selector collects no test until the work adds it to _tools/test_backlog_portable.py.
